injected_entries.notes: Additional cheat-chest button. Enables g_cfgKnockKnock for the current process and closes the chest; it does not modify resource.cfg.

action_overrides.notes: Keep the walk-screen Camp icon on T (0x14), because E (0x12) is strafe-right in the localized control scheme.
